+"""Feedback controller for the single PrepForSanitizing episode.
+
+Run interactively with ``python -i /app/output/gen.py``.  The file contains
+the executed control primitives and can be extended as observations arrive.
+"""
+import json
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = Path('/app/output')
+OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+(OUT / 'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
+cams = list(spec['cameras'])
+print('CONNECTED', spec['control_dt'], cams, flush=True)
+
+def capture(tag, cameras=None, depth=True):
+    cameras = cams if cameras is None else cameras
+    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=cameras, include_depth=depth, video='none')
+    d = OUT / tag
+    d.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    (d / 'meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
+    for c, im in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(im).save(d / (c + '.png'))
+    for c, ar in obs.depth.items():
+        np.save(d / (c + '.npy'), ar)
+    print('CAPTURE', tag, 'time_left', obs.meta.get('time_left_s'), flush=True)
+    return obs
+
+def proprio(obs):
+    p = obs.meta['proprio']
+    return dict(zip(p['layout'], p['now']))
+
+def command(rows, tag, cameras=None, depth=False):
+    a = np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float64)
+    if a.ndim == 1:
+        a = a[None,:]
+    cameras = cams if cameras is None else cameras
+    obs = r.submit('joint_position', a, cameras=cameras,
+                   include_depth=depth, video='none', note=tag)
+    d = OUT / tag
+    d.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    (d / 'meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
+    np.save(d / 'actions.npy', a)
+    for c, im in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(im).save(d / (c + '.png'))
+    for c, ar in obs.depth.items():
+        np.save(d / (c + '.npy'), ar)
+    print('COMMAND', tag, 'steps', obs.meta.get('control_steps'),
+          'time_left', obs.meta.get('time_left_s'), 'done', obs.done, flush=True)
+    return obs
+
+obs = capture('initial')
+print('PROPRIO', json.dumps(proprio(obs), indent=2), flush=True)
*** End Patch"));
